Digitization and Tokenization: The Great Taking of "All" Private Assets
July 30, 2026
“I do believe that we’re just at the beginning of the tokenization of all assets,, from real estate, to equity, to bonds..”
Larry Fink, CEO Blackrock
This is a subject that I have discussed on many occasions for years, but the acceleration of this atrocity of mass government theft is now progressing at lightning speed, and openly admitted to by the powers behind the throne. The evildoing Larry Fink, the CEO of Blackrock, who by the way, was Trump’s first choice for Secretary of the Treasury, (Position now filled by Scott Bessent) is also the Chairman of the heinous World Economic Forum (WEF). He also was a staunch supporter of Hillary Clinton and her run for president in 2016. His past is rife with far left-wing politics, so any notion that there is any difference between the democrats and republicans should by now be dismissed.
As well reported today by Parallel Mike of Parallel Systems, Romania’s entire land registry, and every back-up, was fully erased by a cyberattack; just as has been endlessly warned (threatened) about by Fink’s WEF organization. Every single property in Romania was threatened, due to no ownership records being available. All real estate markets, mortgage applications, notary services for land transfers were shut down. When no hard copy of deeds exist, and all is digitized, no one effectively owns anything, but that is exactly where we are headed. This is already the case with stocks and bonds, but the ruling class of globalists, desire to tokenize every asset on earth, including all property, financial assets, and even all individuals and their identities. If (when) this occurs, you will own nothing, and will lose control of everything you have ever worked for during your life.
This cyberattack scenario has happened many times in the near past, and seems to be a play to set up universal taking by way of digitizing and then tokenizing assets. Does this sound impossible to you? Does this sound like a ‘conspiracy theory?’ Does this sound like science fiction? It is none of these things, except a true conspiracy, as this attempt to take over every single asset on earth (The Great Taking) is not only well on its way to coming to fruition, it has been codified into law in Trump’s ‘Genius Act.’ This heinous piece of legislation is meant to tokenize every single asset class, by placing a monetary value on every asset by digital asset exchange. A Digital Asset Service Provider will have power to affect:
(i) exchanging digital assets for monetary value;
(ii) exchanging digital assets for other digital assets;
(iii) transferring digital assets to a third party;
(iv) acting as a digital asset custodian; or
(v) participating in financial services relating to digital asset issuance.
The monetary unit that will be used is Trump’s ‘Stablecoin,’ which will be dependent on treasury bond backing (forced debt) administered by a private/government partnership, (Fascist) which will have a wide open back door, making it more dangerous and thieving than a Central Bank Digital Currency. (CBDC) This of course was the plan all along, as Trump used lies to claim his denial of any use of CBDCs while all the time knowing that his Stablecoin was nothing more than a CBDC on steroids.
I was in the finance business for 31 years as a Registered Principal with the SEC, and watched as physical paper stock and bond certificates were over time replaced by digital ownership, which is just one step away from full tokenization. I fought against this, and advised many clients to keep holding onto the physical certificates, but to no avail, as digitization of assets was demanded by most firms. When one does not hold an actual physical ownership certificate, when it becomes digital, the bank or digital holder now takes ownership of that asset away from the actual owner. ‘Legally,’ you no longer have any real claim to that asset, and with tokenization, control over assets by legitimate owners becomes impossible. This is theft by government fiat, and any excuse, any claimed ‘emergency,’ any political dictate, has the ability to program use and/or ownership of all assets tokenized.
Tokenization, the next step after digitization, is the process of converting ownership of an asset into a digital token on a blockchain. This of course is sold to the ‘public’ as a safer way to hold assets, with more convenience, but what is not normally (almost never) discussed is the loss of ownership capability, and the vastly increased risk of theft by government technocrats, and the ability for thieving fascist government partners, to have instant programmable control over all tokenized assets. Do you understand what this means? It means that as Larry Fink’s organization, the WEF, was telegraphing the desired future when the evil Klaus Schwab said; “You will own nothing and be happy.” His statement was not some ideological hope, it was a statement of solidifying a sought after and pursued outcome that is now close to becoming completed.
Once assets are tokenized, a total loss of control becomes the norm. What this means, is that any asset you may own, or thought you owned, can become subject to theft by the State at any moment, and for virtually any reason made up by the controllers of these tokenized assets. The plot is to tokenize absolutely everything, every property, every asset on earth, financial, real estate, stocks, bonds, hard assets, including your own identity and body. This, if allowed to take place, would eliminate all property rights entirely, leaving the masses void of any property, and therefore fully dependent on the State. Your life in entirety would become one as a renter beholding to the very masters you allowed to lord over you under the guise of a ‘benevolent’ government. Nothing of the sort has ever existed, and it never will exist.
“Trump administration’s White House Crypto Council, chaired by Crypto Czar David Sacks, issued recommendations to foster digital asset growth in 2025. One key suggestion in the President’s Report on Digital Assets urges banking regulators to adopt a technology-neutral stance on how banks may hold tokenized securities.” This tokenization is now in high gear, and expanding exponentially.
Tokenized securities, which leverage blockchain or distributed ledger technology to represent assets via digital tokens, fall under the category of real-world assets (RWAs). The report advocates for regulatory clarity that the method of representation—whether traditional or tokenized—should not alter the risk weight applied to a bank’s capital calculations. In other words, this is simply a way to shield banks from liability from the ‘actual’ real owners of assets digitally held.
Though technical in nature, this approach gained traction when the FDIC, Federal Reserve, and OCC issued a clarification on the capital treatment of tokenized securities in the form of a FAQ, affirming equivalent treatment for tokenized securities that confer “identical legal rights” to their non-tokenized counterparts. This development carries significant implications. It paves the way for tokenized securities to scale, with market projections estimating trillions of dollars by 2030. Major players, including the NYSE, Goldman Sachs, Nasdaq, DTCC, BlackRock, BNY Mellon, Citi, and JPMorgan, have already initiated pilots or platforms for tokenized equities, funds, and deposits. As I mentioned, this process of “The Great Taking” of all assets is not only well underway, but significantly and constantly advancing. When in place, remember, that you will own absolutely nothing! If knowledge of this does not bring about a massive awakening, nothing will, especially considering that this is a monstrous consumer society.
Of course, this sought-after stealing of all assets will not be admitted to by this abominable governing system, its corporate partners, its AI systems, the fascist NGOs, or the prostituted media, as these entities will claim to be your savior, and will claim to be building a safety net to protect you, by titling all your assets in their name, after propagandizing the lie that you are at risk from outside interests, hackers, and cyber-attacks. This all while they plot to claim all assets on earth as their own.
It is up to you, all of you, to stop this horrendous plot. Do not allow an AI takeover. Do not allow biometric identification. Do not allow digitization of everything, tokenization of everything, and abandon this hellacious system. If you attempt to change things from within, if you attempt to vote your way out of this, you will fail. Time is now severely limited. If you do nothing, you will own nothing. You decide.
“And with technology, as we know, it can go very, very rapidly.”
Donald Trump
